sentences.en: Everyone opposed it, but they got married all the same.
sentences.zh: 尽管大家都反对，但他们还是结婚了。

sentences.en: Were I in your position, I would oppose that plan.
sentences.zh: 如果我是你的话，我会反对那个计划。

sentences.en: Red, as opposed to green, is a sign of danger.
sentences.zh: 红色表示危险，与之相对的是绿色。

senses.zh: 反对，抗争,使相对,使对照,抵制

mnemonic: 词根记忆：op（相反）+pos（放）+ e→摆出相反的姿态→反对，反抗
